planets.name: MASCARA-4 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of MASCARA-4 with a 2.82-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: MASCARA-4 b was found in 2020 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around MASCARA-4. Its orbit and size follow Zhang et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
